component.name: Viewfinder
component.summary: Take photos with the Light L16's camera modules

description.p: The camera app for the Light L16 on Linux, after Light's own layout: a live preview from the camera modules, autofocus with a tap or a half-press of the shutter, zoom from 28 to 150 mm, and photos saved as LRI files with every module's image.
Auto, ISO priority, shutter priority and manual exposure on dials beside the preview, white balance presets, the timer, burst, a grid and a live histogram, and geotagging with the camera's GPS.
